# T022-A2 all predeclared pairwise summary fields

Each field reports maxima over all repeat pairs, not a selected repeat. Relative L2 uses the first member norm (floor1e-12); cosine null if exactly one vector has zero norm. Raw pairs and tensors remain authoritative. No pass tolerance is introduced.
